3FFF.hypothesis: Dialog/sentence terminator glyph. Always sentence-final. Appears doubled ('앞으로 명·· [3FFF] 앞으로 명·· [3FFF]'). Follows complete clauses with no syllable role. Likely a punctuation glyph or end-of-paragraph marker.

40A1.hypothesis: HM/TM icon glyph (Hidden Machine indicator). Always followed by '·· <movename>' or '··받았다'. Patterns: '[40A1]··받았다' (received HM), '[40A1]··공중날기' (HM Fly), '[40A1]··명상' (Meditate), '[40A1]··물의파동' (Water Pulse), '[40A1]··파도타기' (Surf). The two spaces after suggest icon width.

3C08.hypothesis: Binary padding/data byte. Only appears in record 81 (0x3D28BC) as long repeated sequence '[3C08][3C08]·[3C08]·...'. Outside the main dialog text region. Likely non-text data being misinterpreted by the scanner.

4018.hypothesis: Binary/script bytecode marker. All occurrences in low addresses (0x012A00-0x0A9C64), outside main dialog. Repeated in regular intervals ('디 [4018]···디 [4018]'). Appears in script tables/lookup data, not natural text.

408C.hypothesis: Byte-identical glyph to 0x4093=훗. All occurrences in 0x6BDCE8-0x6F7D58 graphics-table range, not dialog.

398C.hypothesis: Binary data byte, same region as 408C. Addresses 0x6DAAA6-0x6EACA6. Appears in repeating sequences with [378C], [3B8C], [408C] — likely table indices or graphics codes.

4038.hypothesis: Ambiguous — glyph is 핏 but 47% sentence-final + greeting/closer contexts (받으세요, 감사합니다) suggest a polite-marker / pause role using a shared glyph slot. Leaning CONTROL.
